name: log_follow_start
title: Start Log Follow
description: Opens a stateful tail handle on a client log file; read incrementally with log_follow_read. Prefer over repeated log_read polling.

client_id.description: Target HHC client. Absolute routing handle, independent of any connection.

source.description: Named log source (client, mcp-server, mcp-tunnel). Ignored when path is given.

max_lines.description: Maximum backlog lines to return with the new handle.

status.description: completed on success, failed on error.

content.description: Backlog text returned with the new handle.

cursor.description: Resume offset for the next call.

error.description: Machine-readable error code when status is failed.

retryable.description: Whether a failed call may succeed on retry.
